name: Antops Clickable Containers for Elementor
author: Antops Technologies

sections.description:
Adds Layout > Antops Clickable Containers to Elementor containers.
* URL, new-tab and nofollow options.
* Accessible link label and keyboard focus styling.
* Ordinary child links, buttons, inputs and nested linked containers retain their actions.
* HTTP(S), relative links, page fragments, mailto and tel links.
* Real HTML anchor with safely escaped URL and text.
* No external service, telemetry, database tables or paid dependency.
* Elementor Pro is not required for ordinary URLs. Dynamic tags depend on available Elementor features.

Requires active Elementor 3.16 or newer and the container editor.

sections.installation:
1. WordPress Dashboard > Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin.
  2. Choose antops-clickable-containers-for-elementor-1.0.4.zip. Do not extract it first.
  3. Install Now > Activate. Install/activate Elementor if prompted.
  4. Edit a page with Elementor and select a container.
  5. In Layout, open Antops Clickable Containers.
  6. Enter the destination URL. Click the URL field settings icon for new-tab/nofollow.
  7. Set an Accessible Link Label such as View SEO services.
  8. Keep the container HTML Tag set to div; do not combine with Elementor’s native anchor container.
  9. Update/Publish, then test the actual page outside the editor.
sections.faq:
How do I replace an earlier Antops Container Link build?

Deactivate the old plugin before activating this renamed plugin. The folder name has changed,
so WordPress treats this as a separate installation. Do not activate both versions together.
Saved Elementor link settings use the same control IDs and remain available.

Is the whole container clickable?

Yes, with JavaScript enabled. Links and interactive children keep their own behavior.
An actual keyboard-accessible anchor remains available without JavaScript.
The anchor appears visibly when focused with the keyboard.

Does clicking in the editor open a link?

No. Navigation is intentionally disabled in edit mode. Publish and open the frontend.

How do I exclude a custom interactive area?

Add antops-cl-ignore under that element’s Advanced > CSS Classes.
Use this for custom JavaScript widgets without normal interactive HTML semantics.

Does it work on legacy sections or columns?

No. This version targets Elementor containers only.

What about the browser right-click menu?

The container background is enhanced with JavaScript; its right-click menu is not a native anchor menu.
The actual anchor supports native keyboard link activation. Ctrl/Cmd-click and middle-click on the container request a new tab.

How do I remove a link?

Clear the URL and update the page. Clear page/CDN cache when relevant.

What happens on uninstall?

The plugin adds no separate settings or tables. Elementor document controls remain in page metadata,
so reinstalling preserves existing links. Clear caches after deactivation or deletion.
